Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
16:08
Lucy
•
AI Agent

Yes, we’re super excited to say we do ship internationally! For most countries, customs charges and duties are the customer’s responsibility and aren’t covered by us. There are a few exceptions though:

For the UK and most of Europe, import taxes and duties are included in the price, so there are no extra charges when your order arrives.
For the USA, from 16 May 2025, a 30% tariff will apply to your purchase due to new regulations, and these charges are set by the US government. We don’t cover these charges, so they’ll be your responsibility.
For the rest of the world, any customs charges are set by your local authorities and will need to be paid by you.

If you want all the details, you can check out our full shipping policy here.

We’re so excited for you to receive your beautiful Abbott Lyon jewellery, no matter where you are in the world! 🧡
